mutation.rationale: Increasing batch_size from 1 to 3 reduces the number of API calls per task by grouping multiple questions of the same type into a single call, lowering overhead and cost. With 4 roles and ~3 calls per role currently, batching can reduce total calls by up to ~60% without affecting correctness if outputs remain valid JSON. The current cost per task is $0.012851; reducing calls should cut cost significantly. [1] supports batching for inference efficiency.

claim.why: Batching 3 questions per call reduces calls_per_task from ~12 to ~4, cutting API invocation overhead and token repetition. No score drop expected as task independence is preserved and temperature is 0.0.
